tail:
Authored the assigned pair with **7 A items and 4 B examples**, including a proved local Cholesky recurrence lemma needed to justify the solver. The A/B pages have empty bodies and exact manifest inventories.

Scoped checks pass: proof layout (11 items, 21 steps), rendering, content policy, strict proof contracts (11/11), citation fidelity (18 citations), dependency and forward-reference checks, and source fetch verification (4/4). The recurrence proof uses [Cornell’s Cholesky notes](https://www.cs.cornell.edu/courses/cs4220/2026sp/lec/2026-02-09.html) and [Driscoll–Braun, §2.9.3](https://fncbook.com/structure/); it supplies the pivot argument those treatments leave open. The plan locator L621 is stale; the current design at L634 agrees with `plan-spec.json`.

**Run-level Step-1 recording is blocked.** All 11 ordinary record attempts stop with `Duplicate item undefined`: batch 71 has three item IDs stored as strings rather than item objects. The whole-run item-level check also reports six empty inventories in other batches. The previous ten ready records are stale after the A-page manifest change; the new lemma has no record. The last successful batch-level result was level 2, requiring batches 2 and 21, but the current shared dependency artifact cannot be recomputed until the owner repairs batch 71. I left that batch and the shared artifact untouched.
